queries.query: large language model network configuration generation "network configuration" "LLM" OR "large language model"
queries.rationale: Locate primary works that directly generate device/router/switch configurations from LLMs or natural language intent to understand implementations, datasets, and reported failure modes.

queries.query: intent-to-configuration translation "intent to config" "network intent" "natural language"
queries.rationale: Capture literature on translating high-level operator intent into concrete NetOps changes—central operational problem for LLM-driven NetOps.

queries.query: network configuration repair "configuration repair" "automatic repair" "LLM" OR "large language model"
queries.rationale: Find works on repairing incorrect or unsafe configurations, both LLM-based and classical approaches, to compare repair strategies and metrics.
Search for architectures where generation is combined with verification and iterative repair (architectural pattern emphasized by the programme).

queries.query: Veriflow Batfish network verification "network configuration verification" formal verification "reachability"
queries.rationale: Survey existing deterministic network verification tools and formal methods used to validate configurations and invariants; these are natural validators for LLM outputs.

queries.query: LLM hallucination failure modes "hallucination" "large language model" evaluation "network"
queries.rationale: Identify general LLM failure mode analyses (hallucination, factual errors) and literature that connects these phenomena to safety-critical settings like NetOps.

queries.query: tool-augmented LLMs for decision making "tool use" "LLM" "self-correction" ReAct Reflexion
queries.rationale: Collect methods for tool-enabled reasoning, self-correction and agentic workflows that could be applied to NetOps orchestration and validation.

queries.query: safety and reliability of autonomous agents in operations "autonomous agent" "safety" "operations"
queries.rationale: Broader literature on operational safety and reliability for agentic systems, to inform threat models and mitigations for NetOps agents.
Locate benchmark suites and task collections aimed at AIOps/NetOps, including caveats and datasets used for evaluation.

queries.query: benchmark validity generalization distribution shift "benchmark validity" "distribution shift" "LLM evaluation"
queries.rationale: Collect literature critiquing benchmark design, distributional validity, and realism—important for assessing external validity of NetOps evaluations.

queries.query: evaluation metrics for configuration correctness "semantic equivalence" "network invariants" "reachability" "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Identify concrete operational metrics and validators (reachability, ACL correctness, loop-freedom, policy compliance) relevant to NetOps correctness.

queries.query: simulation and emulation environments for NetOps "Mininet" "ns-3" "network emulator" "evaluation environment"
queries.rationale: Find commonly used emulators and simulation platforms for executing and testing configuration changes safely; useful for experiment methods and validation.

queries.query: constrained generation techniques for safety "constrained decoding" "controlled generation" "safety" LLM
queries.rationale: Survey decoding and constraint-enforcement approaches (e.g., constrained decoding, DSLs, templates) to reduce risky outputs in NetOps contexts.

queries.query: uncertainty estimation and calibration for LLMs "calibration" "uncertainty" "ECE" "confidence" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Collect methods to obtain and evaluate model confidence estimates to decide when to defer to validators or humans in NetOps workflows.

queries.query: program repair and automated code repair literature "program repair" "automated program repair" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Neighboring area with mature methods for generate-validate-repair; techniques and metrics may transfer to configuration repair.

queries.query: infrastructure-as-code (IaC) synthesis and verification "IaC" "Terraform" synthesis "configuration synthesis"
queries.rationale: Explore IaC synthesis, verification, and drift detection literature for parallels in declarative network configuration generation and validation.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps change management "change management" "human-in-the-loop" "canary" "shadow testing"
queries.rationale: Gather operational strategies (canarying, shadow deployments, rollbacks) used in practice to safely deploy changes; informs mitigation strategies and experiment design.

queries.query: adversarial evaluation for LLMs and networks "adversarial examples" "stress testing" "LLM robustness"
queries.rationale: Collect approaches for adversarial and stress testing of models and systems to design perturbation experiments and failure-mode analyses.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers and accepted conference/workshop articles (IEEE, ACM, SIGCOMM, INFOCOM, NeurIPS, ACL, ICLR, ICSE, FSE).
ArXiv preprints and technical reports with clear methods and reproducible artifacts.
Tool, dataset, and benchmark repositories with public code or data (GitHub, institutional datasets).
Works describing verification tools (e.g., Veriflow, Batfish) or simulation/emulation platforms relevant to NetOps.
Empirical studies, methodology papers, and systematic critiques of benchmarks or evaluation methods.
exclusion_criteria: Unverifiable blog posts or opinion pieces without primary data or references (unless from major vendor documentation or official whitepapers).
Papers that only evaluate generic LLM knowledge without operational NetOps relevance.
Proprietary datasets or closed-source tools that cannot be inspected or reproduced (unless accompanied by detailed reproducible descriptions).
date_rationale: Prioritize recent (2020–present) work because LLM and agentic NetOps literature evolves rapidly; include earlier foundational work (pre-2020) for verification/formal-methods and network-tool history to ground validators.
